name: Soldering Iron Kit (adjustable)
desc: Melts solder to join wires and pins permanently. Needed for modules that ship with loose header pins.
note: The tip is about 350°C. Always use the stand, work in a ventilated room, and wash your hands after handling solder.

name: Digital Multimeter
desc: Measures voltage, resistance and continuity (beeps when two points are connected). Your best friend for finding wiring mistakes.
note: Beginner rule: only measure low-voltage circuits (batteries, boards), never wall sockets.

name: Wire Stripper / Cutter
desc: Cuts wire and removes its plastic coating cleanly without nicking the copper.

name: Hot Glue Gun
desc: Sticks your project into its case and holds wires in place. The fastest way to make a build look finished.
note: The nozzle and fresh glue are hot enough to burn skin.
